$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFGT (AIP France, chart dated 2026-07-09): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Sarrebourg - Buhl

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of RWY prohibited.
ACFT TKOF or LDG must be stopped if a glider lies on the unpaved RWY on less than a half width of its SE limit.
PHALSBOURG BOURSCHEID air base with associated IFR procedures, notably when RWY 06 in use.
Very high sensitivity of unpaved RWY to bad weather and precipitation.
Frequent presence of molehill on unpaved RWY.
Inquire about the practicability of the RWY from one of the ACB.
Curved RWY: no visibility from one THR to another.
Gliding activity possible on paved RWY.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Preferred QFU 220° due to noise pollution.
ACL: apron ALT in front of windsock: 853 ft.
Follow indicated AD circuit as much as possible.
Radio contact with PHALSBOURG is required in D class CTR except if strictly following published AD circuit of SARREBOURG BUHL.
AEM NR 8053: see AIP ENR 5.5
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radios.
Utilisation simultanée des pistes interdite.
Tout TKOF ou LDG d'ACFT est suspendu si un planeur est immobilisé sur la piste non revêtue à moins d'une demi-largeur de la limite SE de celle-ci.
Proximité de la base aérienne de PHALSBOURG BOURSCHEID et ses procédures IFR associées, notamment si piste 06 en service.
Très forte sensibilité de la piste non revêtue aux intempéries et précipitations.
Présence fréquente de taupinières sur piste non revêtue.
Se renseigner sur la praticabilité de la piste auprès d'un des ACB.
Piste bombée : pas de visibilité d'un seuil à l'autre.
Activité vol à voile possible sur la piste revêtue.
Roulage interdit hors piste et TWY.
QFU 220° préférentiel cause nuisances sonores.
ACL : ALT parking devant manche à air : 853 ft.
Respecter dans la mesure du possible le circuit d'aérodrome publié.
Le contact radio avec PHALSBOURG est obligatoire dans la CTR de classe D, sauf dans le cadre du respect strict du circuit d'aérodrome de SARREBOURG BUHL.
AEM N° 8053 : voir AIP ENR 5.5
